name: Icon Metals Machining & Fabrication
old_description: From custom fabrication to CNC machining, Icon Metals delivers superior quality and exceptional service for all your metal manufacturing needs.
about:
Icon Metals Machining & Fabrication operates from Freedom, Wisconsin, a community in Outagamie County. The company was founded in 2016, emerging from a predecessor business known as Mike's Welding. The rebranding marked an expansion of capabilities while retaining a focus on craftsmanship.

The shop provides CNC machining, fabrication, tube laser cutting, structural steel fabrication, gear and sprocket hobbing, and tube bending. Equipment includes a Hurco VM2 CNC mill, a Kia Super Turn 21 CNC lathe, a Dianichi F250 CNC lathe, and a BLM LT8 tube laser capable of processing up to 8-inch square or 23-pounds-per-foot material. The facility employs 13 people and has completed more than 15,000 projects since inception.

The company serves customers requiring custom metalwork across a range of industries, though specific sectors are not detailed in its public materials. Its service list suggests relevance to industrial equipment, agricultural machinery, and structural construction markets.

Icon Metals states its goal is to exceed customer expectations through superior welding, fabrication, tube lasering, bending, and machining services, positioning itself as a trusted partner with an emphasis on exceptional customer service. The business highlights ten years in business and a single mission to deliver quality.
